details.title: Café reading plan
details.content: Café reading plan Open Index · Interface Atlas 3 selected notes in original document order 1. Document order is the first layout Topic: Structure Before drawing a column, put the page in reading order. Start with its name, explain its purpose, then place the action beside the information needed to choose it. Read the source from top to bottom. It should sound like one conversation. A narrow screen is a useful check: when columns become a line, does the explanation still arrive before the decision? Keep that relationship in the HTML. A visual arrangement can change with the available space without making the reader reconstruct the sequence. Source: https://tamir39.github.io/interface-atlas/styles/web-brutalism/preview/#document-order --- 4. Set the measure, then read a paragraph Topic: Typography A type sample is easy to admire and easy to misjudge. Put a whole paragraph in the chosen face. Read across a line, find the start of the next one, and pause midway. Comfortable type gives the eye enough room to resume without hunting. Try a long heading, a familiar sentence, and a word that will not break conveniently. Then narrow the page and enlarge the text. Keep the body measure modest, let headings wrap, and leave enough space between ideas to show their relationship. The exact font available on a reader’s machine may differ from yours. Source: https://tamir39.github.io/interface-atlas/styles/web-brutalism/preview/#reading-type --- 6. Feedback does not have to travel Topic: Motion Begin with the still version of an interaction. A checkbox shows its check, a message names the result, and an active control can underline its words. These cues let someone understand what happened without following an object across the screen. If movement adds useful context, make it a small, deliberate choice and respect the device preference. A reduced-motion view still needs the same facts and actions. On this page, optional feedback changes only a border’s color; the document, links, and controls keep their positions. Source: https://tamir39.github.io/interface-atlas/styles/web-brutalism/preview/#motion-choice Original Atlas notes. Manual copy of a browser-local reading plan.

Fifteen extracted source variables retain palette/font/geometry provenance; actual controls and sections explicitly override corners to 0px. Source geometry variables remain unused in this composition. Named font binaries, complete source layouts, density, imagery and components are not reproduced.

Computed contrast excludes hidden/placeholder text, native popup/validation UI, checkbox glyph internals, antialiasing and browser decorations. All visible HTML text, including heading punctuation and disabled-enhancement explanations, is included.

Six original notes are static HTML. Filter, selection, plan title and preferences live only in the current page; reload resets enhancements. A real download exports selected original notes as plain UTF-8. No account, durable save or backend exists.
